title: On the ratio of surjective group homomorphisms to ring homomorphisms between cyclic rings
description: For n | m there are phi(n) surjective group homomorphisms Z_m -> Z_n and 2^omega(n) ring homomorphisms. Their ratio rho(n) is 2^eps(n) times the number of squares in (Z/nZ)^x, with eps(n) in {-1,0,1} fixed by the power of 2 dividing n, and for odd n the ring homomorphisms correspond to the subfields of degree at most 2 of Q(zeta_n). The paper gives two-term asymptotic formulas, with explicit constants, for the number of n <= x with rho(n) not an integer and for the partial sums of rho, checked against exact counts up to 2*10^10. The archive contains the manuscript, its LaTeX source and figures, and the C and Python programs and data used for the numerical checks.
